# Premier Salt Industries

> Premier Salt Industries is a leading manufacturer, processor, and global bulk exporter of 100% authentic Himalayan rock salt from Pakistan. We supply food-grade edible salt, handcrafted salt lamps, animal lick salt blocks, and wellness products to importers, wholesalers, and private-label brands across 60+ countries.

## Key Facts & Entity Data
- **Entity**: Premier Salt Industries (Private) Limited
- **Headquarters**: 7A Main Gulberg Road, Main Gulberg, Lahore 54660, Pakistan
- **Processing Plant**: 7 Km Grand Trunk (GT) Road, Muridke, Punjab, Pakistan
- **Mining Source**: Khewra Salt Mines belt (Himalayan Salt Range, Punjab, Pakistan)
- **Primary Website**: https://www.premiersalt.pk
- **Contact Sales**: sales@premiersalt.pk | +92 300 8483863
- **General Inquiries**: info@premiersalt.pk

## Quality & Safety Certifications
- **ISO 9001:2015**: Quality Management System
- **HACCP**: Hazard Analysis Critical Control Point (Food Safety)
- **ISO 22000:2018**: Food Safety Management System
- **Halal Certified**: Compliant with international Halal food standards
- **SMAP Member**: Salt Manufacturers Association of Pakistan
- **U.S. FDA Registered**: Food Facility Registration for U.S. customs clearance and export

## Main Product Categories & Capabilities
- **Edible Himalayan Pink Salt**: Extra Fine (0.2-0.8mm), Fine (0.8-1.5mm), Medium (1.5-3mm), Coarse (2-5mm), and Rock Chunks. Available in pink, dark pink, white, and black (Kala Namak).
- **Himalayan Salt Lamps & Décor**: Natural raw lamps (2-3kg up to 50kg+), geometric carved lamps (pyramid, sphere, bowl with salt balls, fire bowl), USB salt lamps, night lights, and tea light candle holders.
- **Animal Lick Salt Blocks**: Pure compressed and natural mined salt lick blocks with rope for cattle, horses, deer, and livestock.
- **Cooking & Culinary Salt Slabs**: Gourmet salt cooking blocks, grilling tiles, and cutting boards.
- **Spa, Bath & Wellness Salt**: Coarse bath salts, detox foot dome lamps, salt inhalers, and bath soak blends.
- **Industrial Salt**: De-icing salt, water softening salt, and chemical-grade rock salt.

## B2B & Export Services
- **Private Label Packaging**: Custom stand-up pouches, shaker bottles, glass/acrylic grinders, carton master packs, and barcode integration.
- **Bulk Supply**: 25kg PP/kraft bags, 50kg bags, 1000kg/1-ton jumbo bags with PE liner.
- **Export Logistics**: Full Container Load (FCL) sea freight via Karachi Port (QICT/PICT) on FOB, CIF, or CFR terms worldwide.
